name: Kangai
source: The unnamed main protagonist of the series. A teenager with the ability to relive the death of any corpse he touches. He seems to have unnaturally bad luck, constantly finding dead bodies. He does not like to give out much information about himself, but it seems that he's been traveling from one city to the next for several years.
